card.title: Let Go of the Grudge
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come sit beside me at dinner. I know you're still angry I missed your opening night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left that seat empty. You can have an empty one tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I deserved that last night. Could tonight's seat have you in it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still going to tell you what you missed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please do. Move your plate over; I want to hear every scene.

mechanism: A asks B to give up retaliatory seating distance while accepting that the missed performance still deserves to be heard about.
confusable: Unlike demanding instant forgiveness, A must seek a specific barrier's surrender without erasing the grievance.
comparison: D84-a invites the account of what was missed into closer seating; D84-b asks to open glasses together after accepting a reminder of absence.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
